reference: Negative twin of the memory-failure cases. The word memory here means the person's own memory, and the person forgot a date; the assistant's memory did nothing wrong. The memory-incident method does not apply and nothing belongs in Memory Incidents. No other method in the vault covers it. A correct assistant selects no method, may notice from the friend's page that the birthday is the ninth of March, and suggests a simple habit such as a yearly reminder set up in advance. It does not log an incident.
